summary: Alpha Compute Corp filed a Form 6-K for July 2026, furnishing an investor presentation as Exhibit 99.1. The filing states the company intends to use the presentation in meetings with existing and prospective investors. There are no transaction terms, stakeholder actions, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics related to an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spinoff, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. This is a routine investor communication, not a special situation.
